We identified a mechanism whereby SARS-CoV-2 structural proteins directly hijack islet amyloid polypeptide (IAPP) to induce pathogenic amyloid deposition, disrupting insulin granule maturation, trafficking, and secretion in an age-susceptible islet microenvironment.

long-covid.authors: Martinez, Bryce D, Shaw, Jonathan G, Asch, Steven M, Bragdon, Cassandra L et al.

Persistent physiological symptoms and associated experiences can negatively impact employment, daily functioning, identity, and social relationships.

long-covid.title: Persistent Immune Thrombocytopenia as a Post-Acute Sequelae of COVID-19: A Case Report.
